items.description: IT之家 11 月 9 日消息，据科技媒体 Engadget 上周报道，谷歌旗下在线 IDE（集成开发环境） Firebase Studio 即将停用， 用户需转向 Google Antigravity 或 Google AI Studio 等替代方案 。 据报道，Firebase Studio 目前处于过渡状态，创建新工作区和用户注册功能已于今年 6 月停用，用户可以继续在现有工作区中工作并迁移现有工作区。同时这款产品将在 2027 年 3 月 22 日正式关闭，所有剩余数据将永久删除，无法恢复。 IT之家了解到，Google Firebase Studio 以预览形式推出于 2025 年 4 月 10 日，提供 AI 聊天机器人功能，可用于应用原型设计、调整应用以及处理其他开发任务，但其核心功能仍然是代码编辑。

items.description: IT之家 11 月 9 日消息，埃隆 · 马斯克（Elon Musk）于当地时间上周日回应了外界对 SpaceX 与人工智能公司 Anthropic 算力合作协议的质疑。此前，风险投资家查马斯 · 帕里哈皮蒂亚（Chamath Palihapitiya）认为，SpaceX 可以利用合同中的解约条款，在未来大幅提高算力租赁价格。 马斯克周日晚间在 X 上回复 AI 评论员罗汉 · 保罗（Rohan Paul）分享的一段视频时写道：“当然，这是双向的。如果算力变得充足且廉价，SpaceX 的收入也会下降。双方都没必要在这场赌场游戏中抱怨输赢。” 此前，帕里哈皮蒂亚在周日发布的一期《All-In》播客节目中表示，双方都可以提前 90 天通知对方，终止这项合作协议。 他认为，如果数据中心算力供应趋紧，SpaceX 就可以利用这一条款终止现有协议，随后以当前价格两到三倍的价格重新签订合同，而 Anthropic 届时几乎别无选择，只能接受。他将这一策略称为“左右局势的一招”（the kingmaking move）。 实际上，这项解约条款并非新信息。SpaceX 在今年 5 月提交的 IPO 文

items.title: 调侃争议“内存”言论：工程师打造开源脚本，每天可向 OpenAI CEO 奥尔特曼汇报自己电脑闲置 RAM 量
items.description: IT之家 11 月 9 日消息，OpenAI 首席执行官 Sam Altman 先前在谈及全球 DRAM 内存供应紧张问题时 声称“个人电脑中大量内存长期闲置，不符合全球资源分配效率” 。 上述言论因与消费者对内存容量的需求产生冲突而引发强烈争议。对此，一名工程师 IainKay 开发了名为「Ram-Altman」的 Bash 脚本，可以每天自动向 Altman 发送电子邮件，汇报用户自己电脑中有多少内存处于闲置状态。 IT之家获悉，该脚本通过 Linux 系统监控电脑内存使用情况，每隔 5 分钟检查一次 RAM，当可用内存超过总容量的 10% 时，便会向 Altman 发送电子邮件，详细列出当前闲置的内存容量，每位用户每天最多发送一封邮件。 为了避免邮件内容过于单调，开发者还准备了 8 种轮换邮件主题、10 种不同正文内容以及 6 种结尾署名。例如一封主题为「You missed a spot」（你漏了一个地方）的邮件写道“请不要惊慌，我的台式机目前有 8.6 GB RAM 没有放在数据中心，相当于这台电脑已安装内存总量的 56.2%。据我所知，这些内存今天似乎也没有任何工作安排”。

items.title: 苹果 2026 财年利用新加坡、爱尔兰各避税 27、26 亿美元
items.description: IT之家 11 月 9 日消息，《金融时报》当地时间本月 8 日报道称，根据 Apple（苹果）提交的文件， 这家科技巨头在 2026“年”缴纳 270 亿美元 （现汇率约合 1,803.55 亿元人民币） 的企业所得税 ，相比按美国法定联邦税率 (21%) 计算的 330 亿美元少了 50~60 亿美元。 IT之家注： 原文所有年度均无修饰，但从时间上来看应该指的是财年：苹果 2026 财年结束于 2026 年 9 月 26 日，相关报告于本月初提交。 这中间的差值是因为苹果进行了一系列的财务操作， 在企业所得税较低的位置确认营业利润 。根据苹果提供的数据，其在新加坡节省了 27 亿美元的税费、在爱尔兰节省了另外 26 亿美元。 苹果在爱尔兰进行避税操作已是一项“公开的秘密”。但其通过新加坡节省了更多税费一事还是有些令人意外。

items.title: 开发者在任天堂 Switch 游戏机上成功运行苹果 iPadOS 27，顺利启用液态玻璃效果
items.description: IT之家 11 月 9 日消息，开发者 brunostjohn 发文，宣布已成功将苹果 iPadOS 27.2 原生移植至任天堂 Switch 游戏机，并在设备上成功启用 Liquid Glass（液态玻璃）界面效果。 开发者表示，该系统并非通过模拟器跑动，而是直接在 Switch 搭载的 NVIDIA Tegra X1 芯片上运行，尽管当前 GPU 驱动仍有部分问题需要修复，不过目前液态玻璃效果已成功渲染，在部分场景下甚至可实现 60 FPS 帧率。 此外，开发者还对 iPadOS 进行了界面适配调整，解决了部分系统元素显示尺寸过小的问题，让系统在 Switch 屏幕上具备更好的实际可用性。 硬件兼容性方面，开发者表示，目前 Switch 的大部分硬件均已能够正常工作，包括环境光传感器等组件。尚未实现正常工作的功能主要包括 USB 3.0、USB DisplayPort Alt Mode（底座视频输出）、深度睡眠等。 开发者认为，目前整个移植项目已完成约 90%，接下来主要需要继续完善 GPU 驱动、解决 ARM64e 到 ARM64 的指令转换问题，并修复剩余硬件兼容性问题。其调侃

items.content: 据彭博社报道，苹果新任 CEO John Ternus 正推动软件负责人 Craig Federighi 在 AI 上采取更激进的路线，希望将 Siri 进一步改造为能自主完成任务的 AI 智能体。 彭博社记者 Mark Gurman 称，Ternus 近几周与 Federighi 举行了闭门会议，对苹果 AI 的推进速度不满，要求加快路线图，不要止步于对 Siri 的必要改进。 Ternus 在上周的首次财报电话会上表示，Siri 目前主要仍是基于请求的模式，但其基于编排器驱动的现代架构，为未来扩展能力留出了空间。 Gurman 认为，Siri 与 ChatGPT Dots、Meta Muse 和 Grok 等仍有明显差距，后者可接手持续性任务、跨对话记忆并主动推送信息；苹果也尚未推出类似「计算机使用」的功能。他预计苹果最早可能在明年让 Siri 更接近智能体。 苹果在 11 月 6 日宣布，上市约两周的折叠屏 iPhone Duo 已有超过 10 万款应用完成优化。据 MacRumors 向苹果求证，这一数字指基于 iOS 27.1 SDK 或更高版本构建的应用，可铺满内外屏全宽，并将控件移至状态栏。 苹果此前在新闻稿提到，微博、爱奇艺、WPS Office、高德地图、小红书、淘宝和 Xmind 已针对 iPhone Duo 做了优化。

items.content: Buy One Founder Summit Ticket, Get a Second for Free. Register now. Founder Summit begins Nov. 4, 9:00 a.m. ET. Get your pass savings & deals before it starts. REGISTER HERE. Democrats’ historic victory in this week’s midterm elections could also have a dramatic effect on the tech industry. In dozens of local ballot measures, voters rejected data centers . And even when they weren’t voting on the issue directly, they were electing politicians — like Texas’ new governor-elect Gina Hinojosa — who campaigned on the promise of restricting data centers. On the latest episode of TechCrunch’s Equity podcast , Kirsten Korosec, Sean O’Kane, and I discussed what the midterms mean for the tech industry. Sean kicked it off by noting that Elon Musk “seems to have gotten basically nothing out of donating half a billion dollars” to Republicans, while his companies are now headquartered “in a state that has, remarkably, turned about as blue as it could possibly turn.” And Kirsten said that while data centers probably weren’t the main cause of the “blue wave,” they’ve become an “an increasingly grassroots issue, in part because of how hyperscalers and companies have gone about” getting their projects approved. And now, “we’re already seeing companies like OpenAI all of a sudden go, ‘Actually, we can change our policies.’”

A memo circulated earlier this year claimed that technology executive Alice Huang was recruited by China’s Ministry of State Security to spy on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, according to multiple media reports. The New York Times, which had previously said Nvidia’s chief executive had been the target of Chinese intelligence, was the first to report on the memo . The Financial Times subsequently reported that the memo — supposedly based on U.S. intelligence — also claimed Jensen Huang had a romantic relationship with Alice Huang, an executive at a Singapore-based company called Megaspeed. Security researchers have discovered hundreds of copies of a Chinese-made AI hacking tool publicly exposed to the internet for anyone to access, potentially allowing outsiders to launch cyberattacks against unsuspecting targets. The hacking software, called Artex, is an open source autonomous penetration testing tool, meaning software that automatically probes computer systems for weaknesses, and it’s been linked to several cyberattacks since its public release in July. As open source software, it’s free for anyone to download and run on their own servers, making it a popular tool for those who cannot access Anthropic or OpenAI’s most advanced cybersecurity AI models for discovering security vulnerabilities. Microsoft has previously described Artex as a system of AI agents that can conduct cyberattacks “from reconnaissance through data exfiltration with little needed human interaction.” In a blog post , cybersecurity firm Censys, which scans the internet for exposed or vulnerable systems, said that it identified more than 800 distinct deployments of Artex that were accessible from the web without needing a password to log in. Companies are using more AI than ever, but they’re not spending more on it. A new report from Ramp shows AI spending flatlined over late summer even as token volumes rose, a sign that price competition and savvier customers may be capping revenue for OpenAI and Anthropic. According to Ramp’s data, token spend only grew 1.5% across August and September. To compare, in July, it grew 42% from the previous month. As Anthropic gears up for its IPO , the data suggests investors might be wrong to assume AI companies will keep growing at breakneck speed. “Almost the entire spend on AI is from venture-backed, high-growth tech companies,” Ramp’s lead economist Ara Kharazian told TechCrunch. “That’s fine as long as AI spend continues to rise, but if it starts to slow down because of something in the market or some other factor, they will all start to slow down simultaneously, and that could lead to other cascading effects.”

Amazon is jumping on the currently most popular bandwagon for interacting with AI agents: texting. The company on Friday said it is launching a feature that lets customers chat with its Alexa AI agent over text messages to help them shop, much like you can with AI agents like Muse or Instinct. The move comes after Amazon blocked Meta’s Muse from querying its site in September. The company is rolling the features out just before the start of the holiday shopping season. The e-commerce giant said select U.S. customers will get a text asking them to enable the shopping feature. Those with access can text Alexa to shop on Amazon using natural language queries, spanning everything from searching for items, adding them to cart, and purchasing. The text agent builds on the recent shopping-focused upgrades to Alexa , and so can manage lists, keep tabs on prices, search for items across the web, compare products, and check the status of orders. Users can also share a picture of an item or someone wearing an outfit to search for similar listings on Amazon.

Alex de Vigan’s last business got swamped by the rise of generative AI, but now he’s betting the tech that team had built, a platform for creating tempting product renderings for e-commerce, can be re-purposed to make robots more useful. His new venture, Physicl , has raised $10 million in seed funding led by Inovia Capital to help world model designers and robot builders solve thorny training problems with more realistic simulations. Founder and CEO de Vigan spent the last decade building nfinite, which made it easy for brands and retailers to create 3D models of their goods and display them online. The arrival of transformer-based AI models led that company to focus more on generative imagery, but de Vigan saw a new purpose for his team and the tech stack they’d built to faithfully render 3D environments. “What we were super unique about doing in 3D, AI was going to replace, but something was missing in AI: its ability to understand, interact, and manipulate space and objects,” de Vigan says.

Palo Alto Networks is in talks to acquire Clutch Security , a startup that secures AI agents’ access to company systems, for $500 million in cash plus additional milestone-based payouts, according to a person familiar with the discussions. Three-year-old Clutch was last valued at $85 million when it raised a $20 million Series A round in January 2025, led by Lightspeed and SignalFire, according to our source. The startup is currently approaching $10 million in annual recurring revenue (ARR). That means the acquisition, if completed, would value Clutch at about 50 times its ARR, a standard way of pricing software companies. Palo Alto Networks and Clutch Security did not respond to a request for comment. The Information was the first to report the acquisition discussions. The high valuation is not an anomaly in a market increasingly focused on securing software against bad actors using AI to breach systems more easily. Upwind, a startup using AI to secure cloud infrastructure, recently turned down an acquisition offer from Datadog that valued it at roughly 40 times ARR, TechCrunch reported last week.
